subject.title: Add guarded MCP coordination send route

question: Should coordination writes become a dedicated fixed-key Gateway protocol, or be implemented within the opaque-ID MCP session surface tracked at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/103621?
rationale: This determines the permanent protocol, session-identity, authorization, and ownership contract; automation cannot safely choose that product boundary.

options.title: Use canonical session surface
options.body: Add a capability-gated coordination operation over existing session RPCs with opaque server-derived identity and one guarded write path.

options.title: Sponsor dedicated coordination API
options.body: Explicitly establish the two coordination identities as supported protocol contracts, then prevent ordinary session methods from bypassing their validation and provenance.

options.title: Keep coordination private
options.body: Close the core PR and retain this fleet-specific workflow outside the public OpenClaw protocol surface.

recommendation.title: Use canonical session surface
recommendation.body: Add a capability-gated coordination operation over existing session RPCs with opaque server-derived identity and one guarded write path.

likelyOwner.reason: Authored the maintainer-labeled product-direction issue covering this exact MCP and session boundary.
